Secondary_Symptoms: Periorbital hollows (tear trough deformity); Mild periorbital edema; Eyestrain; Fatigue; Fine wrinkling
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Aankho ke niche kale ghedde (dark circles) hain?; 2. Family me sabko hai ya neend poori nahi hoti?; 3. Eczema/allergy ki history hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Vitamin C 10% serum + Vitamin K + Caffeine eye cream
Popular_Indian_Brands: Caffeine Eye Cream; Derma E; Fixderma Under Eye Gel
Dosage_Frequency: OD or BD (Apply gently around orbital bone at night)
Supportive_Medicines: Hyaluronic acid eye gel; Broad-Spectrum Sunscreen SPF 30+; Tear trough dermal fillers / Carboxytherapy under dermatologist
Precautions_Contraindications: Do NOT apply potent topical steroids under eyes (causes skin thinning, cataracts, and glaucoma); Avoid getting eye gels inside conjunctiva
Home_Care_Advice: Get 7-8 hours of sound sleep daily; Limit screen time and take visual breaks; Drink plenty of water; Avoid rubbing eyes; Treat underlying allergic rhinitis
Lab_Investigations: Hemoglobin (check for anemia); Thyroid Function Test
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Sudden onset unilateral periorbital swelling with pain and double vision (rule out Orbital Cellulitis / Cavernous Sinus Thrombosis)

Primary_Symptoms: Rough, dry, scaly, dull skin with fine cracks and superficial scaling; Mild to moderate generalized pruritus
Secondary_Symptoms: Lichenification; Painful cracking/fissuring on hands/feet; Skin tightness post washing; Erythema
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Skin bohut sookhi, khurduri aur kathi hui lagti hai?; 2. Nahane ke baad khujli aur khichav badhta hai?; 3. Thand me zyada rehta hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Liquid Paraffin 13.2% + White Soft Paraffin 14.5% lotion / cream OR Urea 10% cream
Popular_Indian_Brands: Venusia Max; Cetaphil Dam; Moisturex; Dermadew
Dosage_Frequency: Apply liberally 3-4 times daily, especially immediately post bath
Supportive_Medicines: Squalane oil; Glycerin 15% lotion; Soap-free cleansers (Cetaphil / Dermadew wash)
Precautions_Contraindications: Avoid using hot water for showers (hot water strips natural skin lipids); Avoid harsh antibacterial soaps; Emollients are safe for daily long-term use
Home_Care_Advice: Apply thick emollient lotion within 3 minutes of bathing on damp skin ('soak and seal'); Use lukewarm water for showers; Use gentle soap-free cleansers
Lab_Investigations: Thyroid Function Test (rule out Hypothyroidism); Fasting Blood Glucose; Renal Function Test
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Severe deep bleeding fissures; Widespread secondary bacterial impetigo with pus; Severe uremic xerosis with renal failure

Primary_Symptoms: Small, follicular, rough hyperkeratotic papules ('gooseflesh' / 'strawberry skin' appearance) on outer upper arms/thighs
Secondary_Symptoms: Mild erythema surrounding follicles; Mild pruritus; Rough sandpaper skin texture; Asymptomatic
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Haath ke upar aur jangho par chote-chote khurdure dane (sandpaper/gooseflesh jaisi skin) hain?; 2. Khujli nahi hoti par skin rough lagti hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Salicylic Acid 6% + Urea 10% + Lactic Acid cream
Supportive_Medicines: Topical Tretinoin 0.025% cream at night (under dermatologist); Ammonium lactate 12% lotion; Gentle physical loofah
Precautions_Contraindications: Do NOT pick, scratch, or aggressively scrub papules (causes scarring and hyperpigmentation); Tretinoin Rx only
Home_Care_Advice: Apply keratolytic cream containing Salicylic acid and Urea BD; Gently exfoliate skin with soft loofah during lukewarm bath; Apply thick moisturizers daily
Lab_Investigations: Clinical diagnosis
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Widespread extensive Keratosis Pilaris Atrophicans with hair loss; Secondary severe bacterial folliculitis

Common_Names_Hindi: Machhli jaisi chamdi; Fish scale skin
Primary_Symptoms: Generalized fine, fish-like polygonal scales with upturned edges, prominent on extensor shins and forearms; Flexures spared
Secondary_Symptoms: Palmar hyperlinearity; Keratosis pilaris association; Atopic diathesis; Severe winter xerosis
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Chamdi par machhli ke chhilke (fish scales) jaisi patti jamti hai?; 2. Pairo par patti zyada hai aur kohni ke andar ki jagah saaf hai?; 3. Thand me badhta hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Urea 10% + Salicylic Acid 3% + Liquid Paraffin cream
Dosage_Frequency: BD or TDS (Apply liberally after bathing)
Supportive_Medicines: Liquid paraffin bath oil; Tazarotene / Retinoid creams (under dermatologist care); Lactic acid 12% lotion
Precautions_Contraindications: Do NOT attempt to peel off dry scales forcefully; Requires lifelong daily emollient adherence; Keratolytics caution in young children
Home_Care_Advice: Apply thick urea and salicylic acid emollients twice daily immediately after bathing; Take warm baths with added bath oil; Use humidifiers indoors in winter
Lab_Investigations: Clinical diagnosis; Skin biopsy (absent or reduced stratum granulosum layer); Genetic testing for FLG mutation
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Secondary widespread bacterial superinfection with fever and purulent crusting; Severe painful deep fissuring preventing walking

Primary_Symptoms: Hyperkeratotic, circumscribed, painful papule with a central hard core over pressure points of feet (Corn); Diffuse thickening (Callus)
Secondary_Symptoms: Sharp localized pressure pain on walking; Tenderness on lateral squeezing; Hard yellow keratin ring
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Pair ke tale (sole) ya ungliyo par hard, dard waala gokhru/massa (corn) bana hai?; 2. Chalne par kante jaisa dard hota hai?; 3. Tight joote pehente hain?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Salicylic Acid 40% corn cap / plaster OR Salicylic Acid 17% + Lactic Acid paint
Popular_Indian_Brands: Carnation Corn Caps; Salicylix Paint; Cornex
Dosage_Frequency: Apply corn plaster directly over corn core, change every 48 hours
Supportive_Medicines: Pumice stone gentle filing after warm water soak; Custom orthotic footwear insoles; Silicone toe separators
Precautions_Contraindications: Do NOT use sharp blades or razors at home to cut corns (severe risk of deep infection, especially in diabetics); Contraindicated on diabetic neuropathic feet
Home_Care_Advice: Soak feet in warm water for 15 mins daily and gently rub with pumice stone; Apply corn plaster strictly over central core; Wear soft cushioned comfortable shoes
Lab_Investigations: Clinical diagnosis; X-ray of foot (rule out underlying bony prominent exostosis); Fasting Blood Sugar
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Diabetic patient with corn/callus (requires professional podiatric care to prevent foot ulcer); Secondary infection with pus

Primary_Symptoms: Deep, painful vertical skin fissures/cracks on hyperkeratotic heel borders; Mild bleeding
Secondary_Symptoms: Pain on weight bearing; Localized tenderness; Dry yellow/brown thick skin on heels; Secondary infection
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Aediya phat gayi hain aur chalti waqt dukh-ti hain?; 2. Phate hue chhed se khoon ya dard hota hai?; 3. Sookhi chamdi hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Urea 20% + Salicylic Acid 6% + Lactic Acid + Liquid Paraffin heel cream
Popular_Indian_Brands: Krack Cream; Cotaryl; Moisturex; Dermadew Heel
Dosage_Frequency: BD (Apply thickly at bedtime and wear cotton socks)
Supportive_Medicines: Petroleum jelly (Vaseline); Mupirocin ointment if fissures are deep and infected; Pumice stone
Precautions_Contraindications: Do NOT use razor blades or foot scrapers aggressively on deep bleeding cracks; Keep deep cracks clean to prevent bacterial cellulitis
Home_Care_Advice: Soak feet in warm water for 10 mins, apply thick Urea/Salicylic cream generously over cracked heels, cover with clean cotton socks overnight; Wear closed-heel shoes
Lab_Investigations: Fasting Blood Sugar (rule out diabetic neuropathy/dry skin); Thyroid Function Test
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Deep infected bleeding fissures with surrounding redness, warmth, and purulent discharge; Diabetic patient with non-healing heel fissures

Primary_Symptoms: Exophytic, firm, smooth, raised pink/hyperpigmented scar expanding BEYOND the original wound margin (Keloid)
Secondary_Symptoms: Pruritus; Severe tenderness; Stinging pain; Contracture over joints; Restricted movement
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Chot, acne, ya piercing ke baad jahan zakhm tha wahan badi ubhari hui lal ganth (keloid) ban gayi hai?; 2. Ganth zakhm ki boundary se bahar phail rahi hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Intralesional Triamcinolone Acetonide (TAC 10-40 mg/mL) injection OR Silicone Gel sheet
Adult_Strength_Mg: 10 to 40 mg/mL (Steroid injection strictly by dermatologist)
Dosage_Frequency: Injected once every 3 to 4 weeks by dermatologist
Supportive_Medicines: Topical Silicone Gel applied BD; Pulsed Dye Laser / Cryotherapy under dermatologist; Pressure garments
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Intralesional steroid injections MUST be performed by a qualified dermatologist (risk of local atrophy and hypopigmentation); Avoid non-essential surgery
Home_Care_Advice: Apply Silicone Gel sheet continuously over scar for 12-24 hours daily; Avoid body piercing or cosmetic surgery if prone to keloids; Avoid scratching keloid
Lab_Investigations: Clinical diagnosis; Histopathology (thick, random, eosinophilic collagen bundles)
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Severe painful rapid growth of keloid; Ulceration or secondary bacterial infection within keloid plaque

Primary_Symptoms: Atrophic pitted scars (ice-pick, boxcar, rolling) or hypertrophic raised scars at sites of previous severe acne
Secondary_Symptoms: Facial uneven texture; Post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation; Erythema; Psychological distress
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Muhaase theek hone ke baad gaal par chhote-chhote gaddhe (pitted scars) chhoot gaye hain?; 2. Skin uneven lagti hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Topical Tretinoin 0.025%/0.05% cream OR Glycolic Acid 10% cream (Mild home maintenance)
Dosage_Frequency: OD (Apply pea-sized amount strictly at bedtime)
Supportive_Medicines: Dermatological procedures: Microneedling (Dermaroller), Fractional CO2 Laser, TCA CROSS, Subcision under specialist; Sunscreen SPF 30+
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Tretinoin is Rx; Tretinoin strictly CONTRAINDICATED IN PREGNANCY; Topical creams offer modest improvement; procedural therapy needed for deep pits
Home_Care_Advice: Apply broad-spectrum sunscreen SPF 30+ daily; Apply Tretinoin cream at bedtime; Do NOT pick or squeeze new pimples; Consult dermatologist for procedural scar revision
Lab_Investigations: Clinical grading of acne scars (Goodman and Baron scale)
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Active severe cystic acne flare up co-existing with scars (must clear active acne before procedural scar treatments)

Primary_Symptoms: Linear atrophic erythematous/violaceous (Striae Rubrae) or silvery-white (Striae Albae) bands on abdomen, thighs, breasts
Secondary_Symptoms: Mild itching during early phase; Depressed skin texture; Cosmetic concern
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Pet, thig, ya chhati par lal-neeli ya safed dharidare (stretch marks) patti bani hai?; 2. Pregnancy, weight loss, ya gym/steroid ke baad hui hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Tretinoin 0.05% cream (effective ONLY for early red Striae Rubrae) + Centella Asiatica cream
Dosage_Frequency: OD (Apply gently over red stretch marks at bedtime)
Supportive_Medicines: Hyaluronic acid lotion; Fractional CO2 laser / Microneedling under dermatologist; Cocoa butter / Almond oil moisturizing
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Tretinoin strictly CONTRAINDICATED IN PREGNANCY AND BREASTFEEDING (causes severe fetal harm); Ineffective on old white Striae Albae
Home_Care_Advice: Massage moisturizers containing Hyaluronic acid or Cocoa butter daily; Apply Tretinoin cream ONLY for early red marks (if not pregnant); Maintain stable weight
Lab_Investigations: Clinical evaluation; Cushing syndrome screening (Serum Cortisol, 24h urinary cortisol) if widespread purple striae present
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Rapid onset of broad (>1 cm) deep purple striae across body with weight gain, moon face, and hypertension (Cushing's Syndrome)

Common_Names_Hindi: Kala massa; Age spots; Seborrheic Keratosis
Primary_Symptoms: Sharply demarcated, warty, hyperpigmented 'stuck-on' papules or plaques with a waxy or greasy surface
Secondary_Symptoms: Asymptomatic; Mild itching if irritated by clothing; Variable color (tan to dark black); Multiple lesions
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Chamdi par bhoore/kale rang ka waxy, chipka hua (stuck-on) warty massa hai?; 2. Umar 40+ hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Reassurance (Benign) - No medical drug cure required (Procedural removal if symptomatic)
Supportive_Medicines: Procedural removal under dermatologist: Cryotherapy with liquid nitrogen, Electrocautery, or Shave excision
Precautions_Contraindications: Completely benign skin tumor; Do NOT try to scrape, cut, or burn off warty plaques at home with acid or thread; Rule out Melanoma if changing
Home_Care_Advice: Do not pick, scratch, or try to shave off warty lesions; Protect skin from friction and tight clothing
Lab_Investigations: Dermoscopy (characteristic comedo-like openings, brain-like gyri, milia-like cysts); Skin biopsy if diagnostic doubt
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Leser-Trélat sign (sudden eruption of hundreds of seborrheic keratoses rapidly - sign of internal GI malignancy); Irregular color/border change

Primary_Symptoms: Small, soft, pedunculated (attached by a narrow stalk) flesh-colored or hyperpigmented skin outgrowths in skin folds
Secondary_Symptoms: Asymptomatic; Painful if twisted/thrombosed or caught in zipper/clothing; Multiple lesions
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Garadan, bagal ya groin me chhote, naram, lathakne waale flesh-colored massey (skin tags) hain?; 2. Kapde ya chain me phasne par dard hota hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Reassurance (Benign) - Electrocautery / Snip Excision by Dermatologist
Supportive_Medicines: Simple snip excision or Radiofrequency ablation under local anesthesia by dermatologist
Precautions_Contraindications: Do NOT tie thread/hair or apply chemical acids/home solutions to remove skin tags at home (causes severe inflammation and infection)
Home_Care_Advice: Keep skin folds dry; Lose weight if obese (reduces skin friction); Wear loose clothing around neck and axillae
Lab_Investigations: Fasting Blood Sugar & HbA1c; Lipid profile (associated with Insulin Resistance and Metabolic Syndrome)
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Sudden onset of acute severe pain, blackening, and swelling in a skin tag (thrombosed/torsed skin tag requiring simple excision)

Primary_Symptoms: Firm, dome-shaped, slow-growing subcutaneous nodule with a central punctum; Contains foul cheesy keratinous material
Secondary_Symptoms: Severe pain, redness, and swelling if ruptured or infected; Localized warmth; Discharge of cheesy material
Typical_Duration: Months to years until surgically excised
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Chamdi ke niche ek naram, gol ganth hai jiske muuh par chhota kala dot (punctum) hai?; 2. Dabane par badboo waala safed mawaad nikalta hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Excision of entire cyst wall/capsule by Surgeon OR Antibiotics (if infected)
Supportive_Medicines: Surgical excision under local anesthesia; Paracetamol 650 mg SOS for pain; Warm compress
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Do NOT squeeze or pop cyst (rupture spills keratin into dermis causing severe foreign body inflammation and abscess)
Home_Care_Advice: Apply warm compresses if inflamed; Do not squeeze; Schedule minor surgical excision with complete capsule removal when uninfected
Lab_Investigations: Clinical evaluation; Excisional histopathology
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Infected fluctuant cyst abscess requiring emergency incision and drainage; Rapid growth; Redness extending to surrounding skin

Primary_Symptoms: Sudden appearance of well-demarcated, smooth, round/oval patches of non-scarring hair loss on scalp or beard
Secondary_Symptoms: Exclamation mark hairs at margins; Nail pitting; Asymptomatic rapid hair shedding; Burning sensation
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Sir ya daadhi me achanak gol, chikna (smooth), bina baal waala daag (patch) ban gaya hai?; 2. Khasne par chhota baal dikhta hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Clobetasol propionate 0.05% lotion / ointment OR Intralesional Triamcinolone (strictly under dermatologist)
Supportive_Medicines: Minoxidil 5% topical solution BD; Intralesional steroid injection (Kenacort 5-10 mg/mL) every 4 weeks; Tofacitinib / Baricitinib (biologic for severe forms)
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Potent topical steroid max 56 days on scalp then taper; Intralesional injections strictly by dermatologist
Home_Care_Advice: Apply steroid lotion gently on patch; Avoid aggressive hair pulling, chemical perming, or heat styling; Reassure regarding hair regrowth potential
Lab_Investigations: Thyroid Function Test (TSH); Serum Vitamin D3 & B12; Fasting Blood Sugar; ANA (rule out co-existing autoimmune diseases)
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Alopecia Totalis (complete loss of all scalp hair); Alopecia Universalis (loss of all body hair); Rapidly expanding patches

Common_Names_Hindi: Baal jhadna; Hair Fall; Telogen Effluvium
Primary_Symptoms: Diffuse hair shedding (>100-300 hairs/day) across entire scalp 2-3 months after a triggering event (fever, illness, delivery, surgery, stress)
Secondary_Symptoms: Decreased ponytail volume; Positive hair pull test; Bitemporal thinning; Absence of localized bald patches
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Poore sir se achanak chhuchho me baal jhad rahe hain?; 2. 2-3 mahine pehle high fever (Typhoid/Dengue/COVID), delivery, surgery ya severe stress hua tha?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Minoxidil 2% or 5% topical solution + Biotin & Amino acid hair supplements
Dosage_Frequency: 1 mL BD or OD (applied on dry scalp)
Supportive_Medicines: Biotin 10 mg + Amino Acid capsules OD; Ferrous Ascorbate + Folic acid (if iron deficient); Multivitamins
Precautions_Contraindications: Minoxidil may cause initial transient increased hair shedding during first 2-4 weeks ('minoxidil shed'); Minoxidil is safe OTC; Wash hands after application
Home_Care_Advice: Reassure patient that Telogen Effluvium is temporary and self-limiting; Eat a protein-rich diet (eggs, pulses, sprouts, dairy); Avoid harsh hair treatments and tight hairstyles
Lab_Investigations: Serum Ferritin (Iron stores); Thyroid Function Test (TSH); Complete Blood Count; Serum Vitamin D3 & B12
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Hair fall persisting >6 months (Chronic Telogen Effluvium); Hair fall accompanied by severe scalp itching, redness, or scarring

Primary_Symptoms: Progressive non-scarring hair thinning in a characteristic pattern: bitemporal recession and vertex thinning (Hamilton-Norwood scale)
Secondary_Symptoms: Hair miniaturization (fine short hairs replacing thick terminal hairs); Scalp oiliness; Gradual progression
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Maathe ke dono taraf se hairline piche ja rahi hai aur sir ke beech (vertex) me ganjapan aa raha hai?; 2. Family me papa/bhai ko ganjapan hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Minoxidil 5% topical solution + Finasteride 1 mg (Oral)
Supportive_Medicines: Ketoconazole 2% shampoo 2 times weekly; PRP (Platelet-Rich Plasma) therapy / Hair Transplant under specialist
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Finasteride is Rx, for MEN ONLY, and strictly CONTRAINDICATED in pregnant women or women of childbearing age (causes severe birth defects in male fetus - PREGNANT WOMEN MUST NOT HANDLE CRUSHED TABLETS); Minoxidil OTC
Home_Care_Advice: Apply 1 mL Minoxidil solution twice daily on dry scalp; Wash hands after applying; Continue treatment continuously (stopping results in hair loss reversal in 3-4 months)
Lab_Investigations: Scalp Dermoscopy (Trichoscopy showing >20% hair diameter diversity); Serum Free Testosterone; DHEAS
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Rapid onset hair loss in young male (<18 years); Scalp redness, pain, scaling, or scarring

Common_Names_Hindi: Mahilao me ganjapan; Female Hair Loss
Primary_Symptoms: Progressive diffuse thinning of hair over central scalp/crown with retention of frontal hairline (Ludwig scale)
Secondary_Symptoms: Widening of central hair part ('Christmas tree' pattern); Hair miniaturization; Absence of complete baldness
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Sir ke beech ki maang (central part) chodi hoti ja rahi hai aur baal patle ho rahe hain?; 2. Frontal hairline bani hui hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Minoxidil 2% or 5% topical solution / Foam
Dosage_Frequency: 1 mL OD or BD (applied strictly on central scalp)
Supportive_Medicines: Biotin & Iron supplements; Spironolactone 50 mg OD (anti-androgen under dermatologist); Ketoconazole 2% shampoo
Precautions_Contraindications: Do NOT prescribe or suggest Finasteride for Female Pattern Hair Loss; Minoxidil 2% or 5% is safe; May cause unwanted facial hypertrichosis if solution drips on forehead/cheeks
Home_Care_Advice: Apply 1 mL Minoxidil carefully on dry central scalp daily; Avoid dripping onto forehead/cheeks; Eat a protein-rich balanced diet; Continue maintenance therapy
Lab_Investigations: Serum Ferritin; Total & Free Testosterone; DHEAS; LH/FSH ratio (screen for PCOS); USG Pelvis; TSH
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Rapid diffuse hair loss with menstrual irregularity, acne, and hirsutism (Polycystic Ovary Syndrome / Virilization screening)

Primary_Symptoms: Fine white/gray non-inflammatory scaling flakes on scalp; Mild to moderate scalp pruritus
Secondary_Symptoms: Flakes falling on shoulders; Scalp dryness or mild oiliness; Absence of erythema or thick crusts
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Sir me safed/dhalay rusi (dandruff) ki patti jhadti hai?; 2. Shoulder par flakes girte hain?; 3. Halka khujli hoti hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Ketoconazole 2% shampoo OR Zinc Pyrithione (ZPTO) 1% shampoo
Dosage_Frequency: Use 2 to 3 times weekly (Leave lather on scalp for 5 mins before rinsing)
Supportive_Medicines: Coal tar + Salicylic acid shampoo; Coconut oil application 1 hour before bath
Precautions_Contraindications: Do NOT leave heavy hair oil overnight on scalp (oil promotes Malassezia fungal yeast growth and worsens dandruff); Anti-dandruff shampoo is safe OTC
Home_Care_Advice: Lather shampoo onto wet scalp, leave for 5 minutes before rinsing thoroughly; Wash scalp 2-3 times weekly; Avoid applying heavy oils overnight
Lab_Investigations: Clinical evaluation; Scalp inspection
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Severe scalp erythema, oozing, and thick yellow crusting (Seborrheic Dermatitis flare or Scalp Psoriasis); Unremitting severe itch

Common_Names_Hindi: Sir me mawaad waale dane; Scalp Folliculitis
Primary_Symptoms: Small, painful, pruritic follicular pustules and papules on scalp, often along anterior hairline or crown
Secondary_Symptoms: Perifollicular erythema; Localized soreness; Crust formation; Temporary localized hair loss; Recurrent crops
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Sir ke andar aur hair line par chhote peele mawaad waale dard waale dane hain?; 2. Kanga karne par dard hota hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Clindamycin 1% topical lotion OR Mupirocin 2% ointment + Antiseptic Shampoo
Supportive_Medicines: Ketoconazole 2% + Zinc Pyrithione shampoo 2 times weekly; Oral Doxycycline 100 mg BD (if severe/widespread under doctor)
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Avoid squeezing pustules; Avoid heavy hair oils/gel; Oral antibiotics Rx if widespread
Home_Care_Advice: Wash scalp with antiseptic/antifungal shampoo 2-3 times weekly; Apply Clindamycin lotion pinpoint on pustules; Use clean towels and pillowcases daily
Lab_Investigations: Pustule swab culture and antibiotic sensitivity
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Folliculitis Decalvans (severe scarring folliculitis causing permanent patchy hair loss and tufted hairs); High fever with boggy scalp swelling

Primary_Symptoms: Brittle, soft, dry, or easily splitting nails (Onychoschizia - horizontal splitting; Onychorrhexis - longitudinal ridging)
Secondary_Symptoms: Slow nail growth; Rough nail plate texture; Subungual fissuring; Difficulty growing long nails
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Naakhun patle, sookhe aur jaldi toot/chhil jate hain?; 2. Naakhun me lambi dharaiya (longitudinal ridges) hain?; 3. Pani/sabun ka kaam zyada karte hain?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Biotin 10 mg + Calcium + Amino acid nail supplement + Hydrating Nail Cream
Supportive_Medicines: Petroleum jelly or Urea 10% cream massaged into cuticles nightly; Iron supplements if anemic
Precautions_Contraindications: Do NOT overuse nail polish removers containing acetone; Wear protective gloves during wet dishwashing/cleaning work
Home_Care_Advice: Apply petroleum jelly or nail hydrating cream to cuticles and nail plates every night; Wear cotton-lined rubber gloves for wet chores; Keep nails trimmed short
Lab_Investigations: Serum Ferritin (rule out Iron Deficiency Anemia); Thyroid Function Test (TSH); Complete Blood Count
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Severe dystrophy of all 20 nails (Twenty-Nail Dystrophy); Nail lifting (Onycholysis); Subungual splinter hemorrhages

Common_Names_Hindi: Naakhun chamdi me ghusna; Ingrown Toenail
Primary_Symptoms: Severe localized pain, erythema, and swelling at lateral nail fold of big toe where nail curved into skin
Secondary_Symptoms: Granulation tissue formation; Purulent discharge; Throbbing pain on walking; Difficulty wearing shoes
Typical_Duration: 1 to 3 weeks (requires conservative or minor surgical wedge resection)
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Pair ke bade naakhun (big toe) ka kinara chamdi ke andar ghus gaya hai aur tez dard/pus hai?; 2. Chalne me takleef hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Mupirocin 2% ointment + Warm soaks + Paracetamol 650 mg (plus Minor Surgical Wedge Resection if severe)
Supportive_Medicines: Cephalexin 500 mg TDS (if active surrounding cellulitis under doctor); Cotton wick insertion under nail edge
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Do NOT trim nail corners in a curved shape; Phenol matrixectomy / Partial nail avulsion required for recurrent severe cases
Home_Care_Advice: Soak toe in warm water for 15 mins 3 times daily; Place a tiny piece of sterile cotton under curved nail edge to lift it; Cut toenails strictly STRAIGHT ACROSS
Lab_Investigations: Clinical evaluation; Fasting Blood Sugar (diabetic screening)
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Severe spreading cellulitis of foot; Diabetic patient with ingrown toenail; Exuberant bleeding granulation tissue

Common_Names_Hindi: Awanchniya baal; Hirsutism; Facial hair in women
Primary_Symptoms: Excessive terminal coarse dark hair growth in women in male-pattern distribution (upper lip, chin, chest, abdomen)
Secondary_Symptoms: Acne vulgaris; Menstrual irregularities (oligomenorrhea/amenorrhea); Scalp hair thinning; Male Ferriman-Gallwey score >8
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Chehre (upper lip, chin) aur chhati par aadmiyo jaise kaley motey baal aate hain?; 2. Period/menses irregular hain ya acne hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Eflornithine 13.9% cream (Topical) OR Spironolactone / Cyproterone acetate + Ethinyl Estradiol (Oral under specialist)
Popular_Indian_Brands: Vaniqa Cream; Eflora Cream; Diane-35; Aldactone
Dosage_Frequency: BD (12 hourly applied on clean facial areas)
Supportive_Medicines: Laser Hair Reduction (Nd:YAG laser under dermatologist); Oral Contraceptive Pills (under gynecologist); Weight loss
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Systemic anti-androgens and OCPs are Rx strictly under specialist supervision; Eflornithine cream slows hair growth rate but does NOT remove hair
Home_Care_Advice: Apply Eflornithine cream twice daily at least 8 hours apart; Continue physical hair removal (threading/laser) while cream takes 8-12 weeks to act; Lose weight if overweight
Lab_Investigations: USG Pelvis (screen for PCOS); Serum Total & Free Testosterone; DHEAS; LH/FSH ratio; Fasting Insulin & HbA1c; 17-OH Progesterone
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Rapid onset hirsutism with virilization (clitoromegaly, voice deepening, rapid muscle mass gain - screen for Adrenal/Ovarian Tumor)

Primary_Symptoms: Excessive, uncontrollable focal sweating (palms, soles, axillae) exceeding physiological cooling needs
Secondary_Symptoms: Slippery wet palms; Soaked clothing; Skin maceration; Secondary fungal/bacterial infection; Social anxiety
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Haath, pair ya bagal me itna paniya-pasiina aata hai ki kapde bhig jate hain ya kagaz gilla ho jata hai?; 2. Bin kisi garmi ke aata hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Aluminum Chloride Hexahydrate 20% topical solution OR Glycopyrrolate 1% wipes / Oral Glycopyrrolate
Dosage_Frequency: Apply on dry skin at bedtime, wash off in morning / 1 mg OD
Supportive_Medicines: Iontophoresis (for palms/soles); Botulinum Toxin A (Botox) intradermal injections under dermatologist
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Aluminum chloride solution MUST be applied strictly to dry skin at bedtime to prevent severe skin burning; Oral Glycopyrrolate caution in glaucoma
Home_Care_Advice: Apply antiperspirant solution at night to completely dry skin; Wash off in morning; Wear loose breathable cotton clothing; Use iontophoresis water bath for hands/feet
Lab_Investigations: Thyroid Function Test (TSH); Fasting Blood Sugar; Chest X-ray (rule out secondary causes like Hyperthyroidism, TB, Pheochromocytoma)
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Generalized nocturnal drenching night sweats with fever and weight loss (TB/Lymphoma screening); Sudden unilateral hyperhidrosis

Common_Names_Hindi: Sharir ki badboo; Body Odor; Bromhidrosis
Primary_Symptoms: Foul, pungent, offensive apocrine or eccrine body odor originating mainly from axillae, feet, or groin
Secondary_Symptoms: Excessive sweating; Bacterial decomposition of sweat (Corynebacterium); Stained clothing; Social distress
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Bagal ya pairo se severe badboo (body odor) aati hai jo nahane ke baad bhi nahi jati?; 2. Kapdo par peela daag chhodti hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Clindamycin 1% topical lotion + Benzoyl Peroxide 5% wash + Aluminum Chloride antiperspirant
Popular_Indian_Brands: Clinka Lotion; Persol AC 5; Aldry Lotion
Dosage_Frequency: Apply Clindamycin BD / Benzoyl peroxide wash during bath daily
Supportive_Medicines: Chlorhexidine 2% antiseptic body wash; Zinc dusting powder; Botulinum toxin injections for axillary hyperhidrosis
Precautions_Contraindications: Do NOT apply perfume or deodorants over raw/irritated skin; Benzoyl peroxide wash can bleach colored towels
Home_Care_Advice: Wash axillae and groin daily with Benzoyl peroxide or Chlorhexidine wash; Shave axillary hair (reduces surface area for bacterial sweat trapping); Wear clean cotton clothes daily
Lab_Investigations: Skin swab for bacterial culture and Wood's lamp examination (rule out Erythrasma)
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Sudden change in body odor to sweet/fruity (Diabetic Ketoacidosis) or musty/fishy odor (Trimethylaminuria / Liver failure)

Common_Names_Hindi: Shave ke baad ke dane; Razor Bumps
Primary_Symptoms: Pruritic, painful erythematous papules and pustules on beard area/neck occurring after shaving in individuals with curly hair
Secondary_Symptoms: Incurved foreign-body hair entry; Hyperpigmentation; Keloidal scarring; Secondary bacterial infection
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Shave karne ke baad daadhi ya garadan par lal khujli waale dane aur ghuse hue baal (ingrown hair) bante hain?; 2. Baal ghoom kar chamdi me ghus jata hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Clindamycin 1% + Tretinoin 0.025% gel OR Hydrocortisone 1% cream + Shaving modification
Supportive_Medicines: Glycolic acid 6% lotion; Electric clipper instead of razor blade; Laser hair reduction under dermatologist
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Do NOT pluck or dig out ingrown hairs with unsterilized needles; Tretinoin Rx only
Home_Care_Advice: Switch from manual multi-blade razor to electric beard trimmer; Shave IN THE DIRECTION of hair growth; Apply warm compress before shaving; Use lubricating shave gel
Lab_Investigations: Clinical evaluation; Dermoscopy (ingrown hair shafts)
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Severe secondary bacterial sycosis barbae with extensive purulent abscesses and severe facial scarring

Primary_Symptoms: Sudden onset rapidly progressive systemic hypersensitivity: severe dyspnea, wheezing, laryngeal edema, hypotension, collapse, generalized urticaria
Secondary_Symptoms: Abdominal cramps; Vomiting; Confusion; Tachycardia; Angioedema; Cyanosis; Loss of consciousness
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Kuch khane, dawai ya keede katne ke baad turant saans phooli, gala sooja aur chakkar aakar behoshi hui?; 2. BP drop hua hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Adrenaline IM by trained person while calling emergency services
Dosage_Frequency: Immediate IM injection into mid-outer thigh. Repeat every 5-15 min if non-responsive
Supportive_Medicines: Call Emergency Ambulance; Lay patient flat with legs elevated; High flow Oxygen; IV Fluids (Normal Saline 1-2 Liters); IV Hydrocortisone & Avil
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Life-threatening emergency; Adrenaline IM is the SINGLE MOST CRITICAL LIFESAVING DRUG - administer immediately without delay
Home_Care_Advice: Call emergency services immediately; Administer EpiPen / Auto-injectable Epinephrine 0.3-0.5 mg IM into mid-outer thigh immediately while calling ambulance; Lay flat with legs raised
Lab_Investigations: Arterial Blood Gas; Serum Tryptase level (within 1-2 hours); CBC; Electrolytes; ECG
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Medical emergency - Immediate ER referral; Any patient with respiratory compromise or hypotension post allergen exposure

Primary_Symptoms: Acute onset pruritus, urticaria, angioedema, or vomiting/diarrhea within minutes to 2 hours post specific food ingestion
Secondary_Symptoms: Wheezing; Abdominal pain; Dysphagia; Rhinitis; Anaphylaxis (in severe cases)
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Doodh, aanda, moongphali (peanut), macchli ya gehu khane ke 1-2 ghante me pitta, ulti ya saans phooli hai?; 2. Har baar wahi food khane par hota hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Levocetirizine 5 mg OR Fexofenadine 180 mg + STRICT FOOD ELIMINATION
Supportive_Medicines: Oral Prednisolone 20 mg OD for 3 days if moderate-severe flare; Auto-injectable Epinephrine (EpiPen) for high-risk patients
Precautions_Contraindications: STRICT LIFELONG AVOIDANCE OF IDENTIFIED OFFENDING FOOD ALLERGEN; Read all processed food labels carefully; Always carry EpiPen if history of severe reaction
Home_Care_Advice: Strictly eliminate offending food allergen; Carry EpiPen auto-injector if advised; Inform restaurants/family about food allergy
Lab_Investigations: Specific Serum IgE testing (ImmunoCAP); Skin Prick Testing; Oral Food Challenge (strictly under allergist in hospital)
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Any signs of Anaphylaxis (breathing difficulty, throat tightness, tongue swelling, dizziness, vomiting, drop in BP post food)

Primary_Symptoms: Bilateral intense ocular pruritus (itching); Watery discharge; Conjunctival hyperemia (redness); Chemosis (ocular edema)
Secondary_Symptoms: Ropey discharge; Papillary reaction on upper palpebral conjunctiva; Eyelid edema; Photophobia
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Dono aankho me tez khujli, paani aur lalapan hai?; 2. Chinke aur naak bahna bhi hai?; 3. Mausam badalne par badhta hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Olopatadine 0.1% eye drops OR Ketotifen 0.025% eye drops
Dosage_Frequency: 1 drop in both eyes BD (12 hourly)
Supportive_Medicines: Carboxymethylcellulose 0.5% lubricant eye drops 4 times daily; Cold compresses over closed eyes; Fluticasone nasal spray
Precautions_Contraindications: Do NOT use steroid eye drops without an ophthalmologist prescription (causes irreversible glaucoma and cataracts); Avoid rubbing eyes
Home_Care_Advice: Apply cold compresses over closed eyes 3-4 times daily; Use lubricant eye drops; Wear protective sunglasses outdoors; Avoid rubbing eyes
Lab_Investigations: Slit lamp biomicroscopy; Eosinophils in conjunctival scrapings
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Severe eye pain; Decreased visual acuity; Corneal ulceration or opacity; Purulent thick discharge (bacterial keratitis)

Primary_Symptoms: Linear erythematous wheals and flare appearing within 5-7 minutes along lines of scratching or firm pressure on skin
Secondary_Symptoms: Intense localized itching; Burning sensation; Resolution of wheals within 30-60 minutes; Dermographic skin writing
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Skin par ungli ya naakhun se khujlane par wahin lal ubhari hui patti (line) ban jati hai?; 2. 30-60 minute me apne aap gayab hoti hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Levocetirizine 5 mg OR Fexofenadine 180 mg OR Bilastine 20 mg
Supportive_Medicines: Calamine lotion topically; Hydroxyzine 25 mg BT for severe nocturnal itch
Precautions_Contraindications: Antihistamines suppress symptoms effectively; Drowsiness caution with Cetirizine/Levocetirizine; Avoid tight friction-causing clothing
Home_Care_Advice: Avoid firm rubbing or scratching skin; Wear loose cotton clothing; Use gentle soap-free cleansers; Apply moisturizers smoothly without friction
Lab_Investigations: Frictions testing with a dermographometer or wooden tongue depressor
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Concomitant systemic urticaria with facial angioedema or shortness of breath

Primary_Symptoms: Flaccid, fragile, clear fluid-filled bullae that rupture easily leaving extensive, painful, non-healing erosions on skin and oral mucosa
Secondary_Symptoms: Severe mouth ulcers/pain preventing swallowing; Positive Nikolsky sign; Raw denuded skin; Secondary infection; Weight loss
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Muuh ke andar aur chamdi par severe dard waale fopoole phat kar kachha zakhm (raw erosion) bana rahe hain?; 2. Niklosky sign positive hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Rx - dermatologist supervision required (High-dose Systemic Corticosteroids - Prednisolone + Immunosuppressants - Azathioprine / Rituximab)
Duration_Days: Rx - dermatologist supervision required (Months to years)
Supportive_Medicines: Cyclophosphamide / Mycophenolate Mofetil; Oral antiseptic rinses (Chlorhexidine); Potassium Permanganate soaks; PPIs
Precautions_Contraindications: Rx - dermatologist supervision required; High mortality if untreated; High-dose systemic steroids require close monitoring of blood sugar, BP, bone density, and infection; Specialist management mandatory
Home_Care_Advice: Gentle skin handling; Non-adherent sterile dressings over erosions; High protein soft liquid diet; Soft toothbrush; Maintain strict oral hygiene with chlorhexidine mouthwash
Lab_Investigations: Skin/Mucosal Biopsy for Direct Immunofluorescence (DIF - intercellular IgG/C3 deposition); Anti-Desmoglein 1 and 3 ELISA antibodies; CBC; FBS
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Severe widespread denuded skin erosions with secondary bacterial sepsis; Inability to swallow liquids due to oral pain; High fever

Primary_Symptoms: Tense, large, sturdy fluid-filled or hemorrhagic bullae on normal or erythematous skin in elderly (>60 years); Severe pruritus
Secondary_Symptoms: Urticarial precursor plaques; Widespread erosions; Absence of early mucosal involvement; Secondary infection
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Umar 60+ hai aur sharir par bade, kadak (tense) paani waale fopoole nikle hain jo aasaani se nahi phatte?; 2. Severe khujli hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Rx - dermatologist supervision required (Systemic Corticosteroids - Prednisolone + Clobetasol 0.05% whole body cream)
Duration_Days: Rx - dermatologist supervision required (Months to years)
Supportive_Medicines: Doxycycline 100 mg BD + Nicotinamide 500 mg TDS (steroid-sparing regimen); Topical Clobetasol propionate whole body application
Precautions_Contraindications: Rx - dermatologist supervision required; Occurs mainly in elderly; Monitor for corticosteroid side effects (hypertension, diabetes, osteoporosis, sepsis); Specialist care required
Home_Care_Advice: Do not puncture bullae manually; Protect skin from friction; Apply non-adherent dressings; High protein diet; Take calcium and Vitamin D supplements
Lab_Investigations: Skin Biopsy for Direct Immunofluorescence (DIF - linear basement membrane zone IgG/C3 deposition); Anti-BP180 and Anti-BP230 ELISA; CBC
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Widespread denuded skin with purulent bacterial infection and high fever; Severe electrolyte imbalance in elderly

Common_Names_Hindi: Pindaliyo par lal ganth; Erythema Nodosum
Primary_Symptoms: Painful, tender, erythematous subcutaneous nodules strictly on anterior shins bilaterally; Fever; Arthralgia
Secondary_Symptoms: Bruise-like color changes (erythema to violaceous to yellow-green); Ankle edema; Malaise; Fatigue
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Pindaliyo (shins) par aage ki taraf lal, garam, aur severe dard waali subcutaneous ganth hai?; 2. Bukhar aur jodon me dard hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Ibuprofen 400 mg OR Indomethacin 25 mg + Bed rest & Leg elevation
Supportive_Medicines: Potassium Iodide oral solution; Paracetamol 650 mg SOS; Compression bandage; Treat underlying cause (TB/Streptococcus/IBD)
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; NSAIDs caution in peptic ulcer and renal failure; Erythema Nodosum is a reactive sign - MUST INVESTIGATE UNDERLYING CAUSE (TB, Strep, Sarcoidosis, IBD)
Home_Care_Advice: Strict bed rest with legs elevated; Apply cool compresses over painful shin nodules; Elastic support compression bandage
Lab_Investigations: Chest X-ray PA view (rule out Primary TB and Sarcoidosis hilar adenopathy); ASO Titer; Mantoux Test; CBC; ESR; Stool for IBD
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; High persistent fever; Severe incapacitating joint swelling; Widespread ulceration of nodules (rule out Erythema Induratum / Vasculitis)

Primary_Symptoms: Malar 'butterfly rash' across nose and cheeks sparing nasolabial folds OR Discoid scaly hyperpigmented plaques with follicular plugging
Secondary_Symptoms: Photosensitivity; Alopecia; Oral mucosal ulcers; Arthralgia; Raynaud's phenomenon
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Chehre par naak aur gaal par butterfly jaisa lal rash hai jo dhoop me badhta hai?; 2. Nasolabial fold saaf hai?; 3. Dhoop se allergy hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Rx - dermatologist supervision required (Topical Tacrolimus 0.1% / Hydrocortisone 1% + Hydroxychloroquine oral under specialist)
Dosage_Frequency: BD (topical) / OD or BD (HCQS under specialist)
Supportive_Medicines: Broad-Spectrum Sunscreen SPF 50+ (PA+++) mandatory; Topical Calcineurin Inhibitors; Prednisolone (for acute flares)
Precautions_Contraindications: Rx - dermatologist supervision required; Hydroxychloroquine requires baseline and annual Ophthalmic Retinal Screening; Strict Sunscreen SPF 50+ mandatory; Systemic Lupus screening mandatory
Home_Care_Advice: STRICT SUN PROTECTION MANDATORY; Apply broad-spectrum sunscreen SPF 50+ every 2 hours outdoors; Wear full-sleeved protective clothing and wide-brimmed hats; Avoid direct sun
Lab_Investigations: ANA (Antinuclear Antibodies by IFA); Anti-dsDNA; Anti-SS-A (Ro) and Anti-SS-B (La); Skin Biopsy for Lupus Band Test; Urine Routine (proteinuria)
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Systemic Lupus flares (nephritis with frothy urine/edema, severe chest pain/pericarditis, high fever, psychosis, severe cytopenias)

Primary_Symptoms: Dry, scaly, fissured, erythematous lips with painful vertical cracking and peeling
Secondary_Symptoms: Stinging pain; Mild bleeding on smiling/opening mouth; Lip itching; Lick-eczema
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Hont sookhe, phate hue aur chhil rahe hain?; 2. Hont par baa-baar jeebh pherne (lip licking) ki aadat hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Petrolatum (Vaseline) OR Coconut oil / Lanocream OR Hydrocortisone 1% cream (short term for severe inflammation)
Dosage_Frequency: Apply petrolatum liberally 4-6 times daily / Hydrocortisone BD for 3 days max
Supportive_Medicines: B-Complex with B12 and Iron supplements; Sun protection lip balm SPF 30
Precautions_Contraindications: Do NOT use potent topical steroids on lip skin; Avoid lip balms containing camphor, menthol, or salicylic acid (they cause contact sensitization and worsen dryness)
Home_Care_Advice: Apply thick white petrolatum jelly or coconut oil frequently; STOP lip-licking habit completely; Drink 2-3 liters of water daily; Use SPF lip balm outdoors
Lab_Investigations: Clinical diagnosis; Serum B12 and Ferritin if chronic refractory cheilitis
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Deep non-healing bleeding lip ulcers lasting >3 weeks (rule out Actinic Cheilitis / Squamous Cell Carcinoma); Severe secondary impetiginization

Primary_Symptoms: Erythematous, dry, painful skin without vesicles/blisters following thermal or hot liquid contact
Secondary_Symptoms: Localized tenderness; Warmth; Mild localized edema; Desquamation (peeling after days)
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Garam paani, chai, ya bartan se halki chamdi lal hui hai?; 2. Fopoole (blisters) to nahi bane?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Silver Sulfadiazine 1% cream OR Mupirocin 2% ointment + Paracetamol 650 mg
Dosage_Frequency: Apply thin layer BD or TDS / Paracetamol TDS SOS
Supportive_Medicines: Aloe vera gel; Chlorhexidine antiseptic tulle dressing; Tetanus Toxoid (TT) vaccine booster
Precautions_Contraindications: COOL BURN IMMEDIATELY WITH RUNNING TAP WATER FOR 10-15 MINUTES; Do NOT apply ice, toothpaste, butter, or ink on burns; Silver sulfadiazine caution in sulfa allergy
Home_Care_Advice: Run cool tap water over burn continuously for 15 mins immediately; Apply Silver Sulfadiazine cream gently; Cover loosely with sterile non-adherent bandage; Drink fluids
Lab_Investigations: Clinical diagnosis; Assess Total Body Surface Area (TBSA) burned
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Burns involving face, eyes, hands, feet, perineum, or major joints; Second/Third-degree burns with blisters covering >5% body surface; Electrical/Chemical burns

Common_Names_Hindi: Chot; Chhili hui skin; Minor Cut
Primary_Symptoms: Superficial epidermal and dermal breach, abrasion, or clean cut with mild oozing of blood
Secondary_Symptoms: Localized pain; Tenderness; Mild erythema; Scab formation
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Chhoti chot ya kharoch (cut/abrasion) aayi hai?; 2. Khoon ruk gaya hai?; 3. Zang (rust) waale lohe se laga hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Mupirocin 2% ointment OR Povidone-Iodine 5% ointment + Tetanus Toxoid vaccine
Supportive_Medicines: Clean sterile dressing; Paracetamol 500 mg SOS for pain; Tetanus Toxoid 0.5 mL IM injection within 24 hours
Precautions_Contraindications: Wash cut immediately with clean running tap water and soap; Apply firm pressure with clean cloth for 5 mins to stop bleeding; Get Tetanus vaccine within 24h if >5 years since last shot
Home_Care_Advice: Wash cut with clean water and gentle soap; Apply Povidone-Iodine or Mupirocin; Cover with sterile adhesive bandage (Band-Aid); Change dressing daily
Lab_Investigations: Clinical diagnosis
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Deep gaping wound requiring surgical suturing; Uncontrolled arterial bleeding; Wound caused by animal/human bite or rusty dirty nail; Signs of tetanus

Common_Names_Hindi: Tale ka massa; Plantar Wart; Verruca Plantaris
Primary_Symptoms: Hyperkeratotic, painful, flat or endophytic papules on pressure points of soles with central punctate black dots
Secondary_Symptoms: Severe pinpoint tenderness on lateral compression; Pain on walking; Difficulty wearing footwear; Koebnerization
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Pair ke tale (sole) par painful flat massa hai jiske andar chhote kale dot dikhte hain?; 2. Side se dabane par kante jaisa dard hota hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Salicylic Acid 17% + Lactic Acid 17% paint OR Salicylic Acid 40% plasters
Popular_Indian_Brands: Salislic Paint; Compound W; Carnation Plaster
Dosage_Frequency: Apply paint pinpoint after soaking foot and filing dead skin OD at bedtime
Supportive_Medicines: Cryotherapy with Liquid Nitrogen / Electrocautery under dermatologist; Retinoic acid 0.05% gel
Precautions_Contraindications: Do NOT attempt to cut or pare plantar wart with razor blades at home (high risk of deep bacterial infection and viral spreading); Caution in diabetic feet
Home_Care_Advice: Soak foot in warm water for 15 mins, pare top dead skin gently with emery board, apply Salicylic paint strictly on wart core; Protect surrounding skin with petroleum jelly
Lab_Investigations: Clinical diagnosis; Dermoscopy (characteristic thrombosed capillary black dots)
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Diabetic patient with plantar lesions; Severe pain preventing walking; Widespread recalcitrant mosaic plantar warts

Common_Names_Hindi: HFMD; Hath pair muuh ki bimari
Primary_Symptoms: Erythematous maculopapular rash and oval grey vesicles on palms, soles, buttocks, and painful oral aphthous-like erosions
Secondary_Symptoms: Low-grade fever; Sore throat; Anorexia; Malaise; Irritability; Late nail shedding (Onychomadesis)
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Bachhe ke haath, pair, hips aur muuh ke andar paani waale fopoole/chhale hain?; 2. Halka bukhar aur nigalne me takleef hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Symptomatic supportive treatment + Paracetamol + Calamine lotion
Supportive_Medicines: Calamine lotion topically; Choline salicylate + Lignocaine oral gel for painful mouth ulcers before meals; ORS
Precautions_Contraindications: Highly contagious enteroviral infection (Coxsackievirus A16 / EV-71); Do NOT give Aspirin to children (Reye's syndrome risk); Self-limiting viral disease
Home_Care_Advice: Isolate child at home for 7 days; Give cool liquids, ice cream, soft bland food; Maintain oral hydration with ORS; Practice strict handwashing
Lab_Investigations: Clinical diagnosis; RT-PCR for Enterovirus / Coxsackievirus if atypical
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Dehydration due to refusal of oral fluids; High persistent fever >3 days; Neurological complications (myoclonic jerks, ataxia, lethargy - EV-71 complications)

Primary_Symptoms: Erythematous scaly annular ring-like plaque with active border on face; Severe itching; Photosensitivity
Secondary_Symptoms: Mild burning; Scaling; Post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation; Erythema
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Chehre (gaal, maatha) par gol lal khujli waala chakatta (ring) bana hai?; 2. Steroid cream (Betnovate/Skinlite) lagane se badha hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Terbinafine 1% cream OR Sertaconazole 2% cream
Supportive_Medicines: Levocetirizine 5 mg OD at bedtime; Gentle face cleanser; Non-comedogenic moisturizer
Precautions_Contraindications: STRICTLY CONTRAINDICATED TO USE STEROID CREAMS ON FACE (Causes Tinea Incognito - masking and severe exacerbation of fungal infection); Avoid eye contact
Home_Care_Advice: Wash face with gentle cleanser; Apply Terbinafine cream BD 2 cm beyond advancing border; Do NOT use steroid creams or heavy cosmetics; Do not share towels
Lab_Investigations: KOH preparation of skin scraping from advancing scaly border
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Severe Tinea Incognito due to long-term steroid abuse; Secondary bacterial infection with purulent discharge

Primary_Symptoms: Intense pruritus in pubic hair region, worst at night; Visible tiny crab lice or nits attached to pubic hair shafts
Secondary_Symptoms: Maculae caeruleae (slate-gray blue macules on thighs/abdomen from louse bites); Excoriations; Secondary impetigo
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Guptang ke baalo (pubic region) me severe khujli hoti hai?; 2. Baalo me chhote joo ya safed aande (nits) dikhte hain?; 3. Blue spots hain?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Permethrin 1% lotion / wash OR Ivermectin 0.5% lotion
Dosage_Frequency: Apply on clean dry pubic hair and surrounding hair, leave for 10 minutes, rinse off. Repeat after 7 days
Supportive_Medicines: Levocetirizine 5 mg OD for itch; Treat sexual partners simultaneously; Screen for other STIs
Precautions_Contraindications: SEXUAL PARTNERS AND HOUSEHOLD CONTACTS MUST BE TREATED SIMULTANEOUSLY; Wash all underwear and bedding in hot water; Screen for co-existing STIs
Home_Care_Advice: Apply Permethrin lotion to pubic, groin, thighs, and perianal hair for 10 mins; Wash off thoroughly; Repeat after 7 days; Wash all clothes/underwear in hot water (>60C)
Lab_Investigations: Microscopic identification of Pthirus pubis louse or nits; Serological screening for Syphilis and HIV
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Involvement of eyelashes/eyebrows (Pediculosis ciliaris - requires special petrolatum/occlusive treatment); Secondary severe bacterial cellulitis

Primary_Symptoms: Sudden eruption of widespread, monomorphic, painful, punched-out umbilicated vesicles/erosions over pre-existing eczema skin
Secondary_Symptoms: High fever; Chills; Malaise; Lymphadenopathy; Systemic toxicity; Secondary bacterial superinfection
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Eczema/khujli waali skin par achanak poore me chhote-chhote paani waale fopoole (vesicles) aur gaddhedar zakhm (punched-out ulcers) phail gaye hain?; 2. High fever hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: None - emergency hospital referral
Popular_Indian_Brands: Injection Acyclovir IV (5-10 mg/kg 8 hourly) OR Oral Acyclovir 400 mg 5 times daily
Dosage_Frequency: Immediate IV/Oral emergency administration in hospital
Supportive_Medicines: Hospital admission; IV Acyclovir; IV Antibiotics (for secondary bacterial infection); Potassium Permanganate soaks; Emollients
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Life-threatening emergency; STOP ALL TOPICAL STEROIDS IMMEDIATELY; Immediate systemic antiviral therapy mandatory
Home_Care_Advice: Immediate emergency transfer to hospital dermatology ward; Do NOT apply topical steroid creams; Keep patient wrapped in clean sterile sheet
Lab_Investigations: Tzanck smear (multinucleated giant cells); HSV-1/2 PCR or Viral Culture; Swab for bacterial culture & sensitivity; CBC
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Medical emergency - Immediate ER referral; Widespread punched-out herpetic vesicles on eczema skin; Ocular herpes involvement; Systemic toxicity

Primary_Symptoms: Non-blanchable erythema of intact skin over bony prominence (Stage 1); Partial-thickness skin loss with exposed dermis/blister (Stage 2)
Secondary_Symptoms: Localized pain; Tenderness; Warmth or coolness; Shallow open ulcer with red-pink wound bed; Absence of slough
Typical_Duration: Weeks to months (requires strict pressure offloading)
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Bedridden/paralyzed patient ko peth, kamar (sacrum) ya aedi par lalapan ya chhota chhilne waala zakhm (bedsore) bana hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Povidone-Iodine 5% ointment / Hydrogel dressing + Mupirocin 2% cream + Strict Pressure Offloading
Supportive_Medicines: Air mattress / Water bed; Position turning every 2 hours; Zinc Oxide barrier ointment; High protein nutrition
Precautions_Contraindications: STRICT POSITION TURNING EVERY 2 HOURS IS MANDATORY; Do NOT massage directly over bony reddened areas; Do NOT let wound dry out completely
Home_Care_Advice: Turn bedridden patient position every 2 hours continuously; Use dynamic air mattress; Keep skin clean and dry; Apply hydrogel/povidone dressing; High protein diet
Lab_Investigations: Wound swab culture and sensitivity if infected; Fasting Blood Sugar; Serum Albumin; HbA1c
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Stage 3-4 pressure ulcer (deep muscle/bone exposure); Foul-smelling purulent discharge with necrotic black tissue (requires surgical debridement); High fever
